The '''Cargamalis system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Bruanii sector/Legends|Bruanii sector]], at the far edge of the<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" /> [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion<ref name="Atlas" /> of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" /> It was the last stop on the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] before passing through [[Mugaari Space/Legends|Mugaari Space]] and entering the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Cargamalis system was created for "[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]," a [[2004]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[Wizards.com|online]] supplement for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Galactic Gazetteer" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the system in grid square K-18.<ref name="Atlas" />
